note: Independent source rejudgment against the complete RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 Active Event 18 list (rfc/full/rfc4271.txt:3355-3376): restart ConnectRetryTimer with its initial value, stop/clear DelayOpenTimer, release resources, increment ConnectRetryCounter, optional damping, and Idle. DelayOpen is implemented: handleActive first consults handleDelayOpen, Event 17 can retain the connection in Active, Event 18 starts retry and increments the counter, and FSM.change preserves that retry at its Idle transition while clearing DelayOpen. The corrected gap annotation names the actual remaining producer defect: Session.handleConnectionCloseLocked delivers Event 18 and then immediately calls timers.StopAll, cancelling the newly restarted ConnectRetryTimer; Peer.run uses its separate exponential reconnect backoff rather than preserving the initial-value retry. No test tags this row. Untagged TestRFC4271ActiveEvent18WithDelayOpen reaches the real passive Peer, checking Idle, counter increment, nil connection and stopped DelayOpen, but never checks live retry; the FSM-only DelayOpenEventsActive test checks the retry before Session teardown. Thus the full producer's restart clause is unmet, not merely an absent tag and not an absent optional feature. Verdict unimplemented.
